title: get login page without session
description: Verify that a GET request to /login without an active session returns a 200 status with the HTML sign-in form and accepts an optional next redirect parameter.

title: get auth callback with valid code and next
description: Verify that a GET request to /auth/callback with a valid code and a same-origin next parameter sets a session cookie and responds with a 307 redirect to the next URL.

title: get auth callback with malicious next parameter
description: Verify that a GET request to /auth/callback with a valid code but a non-same-origin next parameter sanitizes the redirect target and responds with a 307 redirect to /.

title: get root with authenticated session
description: Verify that a GET request to / with a valid authenticated session returns a 200 status with the HTML event picker or dashboard.

title: get root without session
description: Verify that a GET request to / without an authenticated session responds with a 307 redirect to /login.

title: get event dashboard with authorized user
description: Verify that a GET request to /{eventCode} with an authenticated user who is a member of the event returns a 200 status with the HTML dashboard and event counters.

title: get event dashboard with unauthorized user
description: Verify that a GET request to /{eventCode} with an authenticated user who is not a member of the event returns a 404 status indicating unknown event code or not-a-member response.

title: get client guest list with client role
description: Verify that a GET request to /{eventCode}/guests with an authenticated client role user returns a 200 status with the HTML guest list.

title: get admin events with admin role
description: Verify that a GET request to /admin/events with an authenticated admin session returns a 200 status with the HTML event list and create-event form.

title: get admin events with non admin role
description: Verify that a GET request to /admin/events with an authenticated event_team session returns a 307 redirect to /, denying access to non-admin users.
